question: An engineer must create a PowerShell script that leverages the Cisco UCS Manager PowerShell module to submit automated requests to Cisco UCS Manager. The engineer must automate the removal of switches from VLANs. Environment variables must provide the VLAN name and switch identifiers. The VLAN must persist when it is removed from the switch port. Which command must the engineer include in the script to accomplish these goals?
theory: Because the VLAN itself must persist and only its membership on one specific switch port should be removed, the script has to first retrieve the VLAN object (Get-UcsVlan), then retrieve the specific member-port object attached to it via Get-UcsVlanMemberPort (filtered by switch/slot/port), and only then pipe that specific object into Remove-UcsVlanMemberPort. Calling Remove-UcsVlan would delete the VLAN entirely, and skipping the Get-UcsVlanMemberPort step leaves no specific port-membership object to target for removal. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
